fresh_source_build.reason: Podman repeatedly hit Docker Hub EOF/connection reset while fetching base images even with the requested proxy. Docker then fetched both base manifests successfully through the same proxy. Three current-source builds were attempted: the first failed on an incomplete conda download; the next two, including the exact buildx command with host networking plus upper/lowercase proxy and NO_PROXY build args, made no progress for about ten minutes in parallel head/build dependency installation and were cancelled. No current-source image was produced.

existing_image_gate.failure_evidence: The old-image delete-path smoke test removed the registry entry while ray::VllmBackend remained alive and continued holding 5810 MiB GPU memory; scheduler reported free_gpu=0.0. This is evidence that the delete-based test was not a valid completed sleep, not evidence about current-source automatic scale-to-zero. A valid current-source test must omit load_format=auto and wait for the keep_alive=0 autoscaler path while the model stays registered.

plot_policy: No value is plotted because a current-source fast-loader run with valid automatic scale-to-zero post-conditions was not obtained.
